claims.text: Racism is an issue that needs to be tackled now
The worst of racism affects entire groups more pressing
Systemic racism and inequality have been ingrained for centuries
Fighting individual acts of racism is crucial

implicit_assumptions: Tackling racism now will improve conditions
Large systemic problems yield greater benefit than isolated incidents

Inference.supporting_quote: "While the fight against individual acts of racism is crucial, solving these more widespread issues could create a more broader impact."
Inference.alternative_interpretation: No alternative interpretation undermines the inductive inference

Evidence.diagnosis: unsupported','analysis'':'Premises mention systemic racism and inequality but lack evidence that addressing them will result in broader impact; no premise connects solving systemic issues to the claimed broader effect, so the inference is not supported.'
Evidence.supporting_quote: Yet, I believe we shouldn't lose sight of larger problems like systemic racism and wide-spread inequality which have been deeply ingrained in our society for centuries.

arbiter.content: The comment justifies the urgency of addressing racism by citing that “systemic racism and wide‑spread inequality … have been deeply ingrained in our society for centuries.” It uses the mere longevity of the problem as a reason to pursue action, which is characteristic of an Appeal to Tradition fallacy.
